items.name: 霞鹜文楷
items.desc: 楷体骨架的手写风正文，长文读着不累眼；基于 Fontworks 的 Klee One 补全字重与简繁。
items.desc_en: A handwriting-flavored kaiti for long-form reading; extended from Fontworks' Klee One.

items.name: 霞鹜文楷 Medium
items.desc: 同文楷的加重字重，小字号与标题下笔画更立得住。
items.desc_en: The same kaiti at a heavier weight; holds up better at small sizes and in headings.

items.name: 思源宋体 SC
items.desc: Adobe 与 Google 联合出品的简体中文衬线（即 Noto Serif CJK SC）；系统里最常缺的就是这一档。
items.desc_en: The Simplified Chinese serif from Adobe & Google (Noto Serif CJK SC) — the weight class stock systems most often lack.

items.name: 思源黑体 SC
items.desc: 同一联盟的简体中文黑体（即 Noto Sans CJK SC）；桌面 Linux 上缺中文黑体时的兜底。
items.desc_en: The companion sans from the same project (Noto Sans CJK SC); a solid fallback where desktop Linux lacks a CJK sans.
